terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: RunCloud9 is provided by its operator ("we", "us", "our"). By creating an account, signing in (email and password, Google, GitHub, or another method we offer), or using RunCloud9, you agree to these terms and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

sections.heading: Eligibility
paragraphs: You must be at least 13 years old, or the minimum age required to use online services in your country, whichever is higher. If you use RunCloud9 on behalf of an organization, you confirm you have authority to bind that organization to these terms.

sections.heading: Accounts
paragraphs: Do not share credentials or create extra accounts to evade usage limits, multiply free sessions, or automate signups. We may require a verified email before you deploy labs.

You are responsible for activity under your account and for keeping your password secure. Tell us promptly through the contact method in the Contact section if you believe your account was accessed without permission.
We may suspend or close accounts that farm free capacity, evade limits, threaten cluster stability, or otherwise abuse the service.

sections.heading: The service
paragraphs: RunCloud9 is an educational and experimental platform for learning distributed systems. We provision short-lived lab environments on shared cloud infrastructure. Features, limits, and availability may change without notice.
Paid plans may be offered later. Today, use is subject to the session and feature limits shown in the product.
There is no service-level agreement. Sessions may fail, queue, or end early for capacity, maintenance, abuse, or technical problems.

RunCloud9 is not a general-purpose hosting provider. Do not rely on it for production, mission-critical, safety-critical, financial, healthcare, emergency-response, or other high-consequence workloads.

sections.heading: Your workloads
paragraphs: You are solely responsible for the designs, code, configurations, credentials, data, requests, network traffic, and other materials you introduce into or cause to be processed through the service.

We do not guarantee that your workloads will be secure, correct, available, durable, or fit for any particular purpose. You are responsible for reviewing what you deploy and for any outcomes in your lab sessions.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
paragraphs: Use RunCloud9 only for lawful learning and architecture experimentation. You must not use the service to:

listItems.label: Attack or probe
listItems.text: disrupt shared infrastructure, probe other users' sessions, scan or attack systems you do not own or control, or run denial-of-service attacks outside provided load tools.

listItems.label: Malware and abuse
listItems.text: upload or run malware, ransomware, credential harvesters, phishing pages, botnets, spam infrastructure, or tools intended to evade security controls.

listItems.label: Resource abuse
listItems.text: mine cryptocurrency, run persistent hosting, consume disproportionate resources, or use labs as a proxy or anonymization service.

listItems.label: Illegal or harmful content
listItems.text: store or distribute illegal content, infringe others' intellectual property, or process regulated data (such as health or payment card data) unless you have a lawful basis and we have agreed in writing.

listItems.label: Limit evasion
listItems.text: circumvent quotas, access controls, or technical restrictions.

sections.heading: Secrets and credentials
paragraphs: Do not place production secrets, live API keys, or credentials you are not authorized to use into lab workloads unless you accept the risk that they may be exposed in a shared learning environment.
You are responsible for rotating or revoking any credentials you expose. We do not guarantee confidentiality of secrets you choose to store in session configurations or designs.

You grant us a non-exclusive, worldwide license to host, store, transmit, display, and process your designs only as needed to operate, secure, and support the service. This license ends when we no longer need it to operate the service, subject to backup and legal retention requirements.
Template presets, platform software, and our branding remain our property or our licensors'. You may not copy, reverse engineer, or resell the service except as these terms allow.

sections.heading: Intellectual property complaints
paragraphs: If you believe content on RunCloud9 infringes your rights, contact us using the method in the Contact section with enough detail for us to locate the material and verify your claim. We may remove content or suspend accounts that repeatedly infringe others' rights.

sections.heading: Third-party services
paragraphs: RunCloud9 depends on third-party infrastructure and services (including cloud providers, authentication, analytics, and error monitoring). Those providers have their own terms and may experience outages or policy changes outside our control. We are not responsible for failures attributable solely to third parties.

sections.heading: Suspension and termination
paragraphs: We may suspend or terminate your access immediately if you violate these terms, create a security risk, engage in fraud or illegal activity, receive a valid legal request, or if we must protect the service or other users.

When a session ends, live cluster resources are destroyed. When an account is closed, we may retain account and deployment history for a period described in our Privacy Policy, then delete or anonymize it subject to legal obligations.

paragraphs: THE SERVICE IS PROVIDED "AS IS" AND "AS AVAILABLE" WITHOUT WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND, WHETHER EXPRESS, IMPLIED, OR STATUTORY, INCLUDING IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, AND NON-INFRINGEMENT.
METRICS, SIMULATIONS, AND LAB BEHAVIOR ARE DIRECTIONAL AND FOR LEARNING ONLY. THEY ARE NOT CERTIFICATION-GRADE OR SUITABLE FOR PRODUCTION DECISIONS.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes how the operator of RunCloud9 ("we", "us", "our") handles information when you use the service at www.runcloud9.io. The operator is the data controller for personal information described here.

listItems.label: Account data
listItems.text: email address, authentication identifiers, and profile information from Supabase, including Google or GitHub sign-in when you use those providers.

listItems.label: Session data
listItems.text: deployment designs, namespace metadata, session duration, and summarized metrics stored with your account.

listItems.label: Device and log data
listItems.text: IP address, browser type, and basic request metadata needed to secure and operate the service.

listItems.label: Usage analytics
listItems.text: product events (for example canvas opened, deploy requested) via PostHog, with coarse error categories, not raw backend error text.

listItems.label: Diagnostics
listItems.text: client errors and performance signals via Sentry when enabled.

listItems.label: Support messages
listItems.text: information you send when you contact us (for example through Discord), including your account email when you provide it for verification.

sections.heading: How we use it
paragraphs: We use personal information to provide and secure the service, provision lab sessions, enforce quotas, authenticate users, respond to support requests, improve reliability and UX, and comply with law. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: Legal bases
paragraphs: Where required by law, we rely on: performance of our contract with you (providing the service); legitimate interests (security, abuse prevention, product improvement); compliance with legal obligations; and your consent where we ask for it explicitly (for example optional analytics where applicable).

sections.heading: Processors and sharing
paragraphs: We use service providers that process data on our instructions:

sections.heading: International transfers
paragraphs: We and our processors may store or process information in countries other than yours, including the United States. We use providers that maintain appropriate safeguards for cross-border transfers as required by their terms and applicable law.

sections.heading: Retention
paragraphs: Live cluster resources are torn down when sessions end. Account and deployment history are kept to operate dashboards and respond to support requests, typically until you delete your account or until we remove inactive accounts after at least twelve months of no sign-in, with notice when practical.
Analytics and error data follow each provider's retention settings. We may retain limited records longer where required for security, fraud prevention, abuse prevention, or legal obligations.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or export your personal information, or to object to or restrict certain processing. To exercise these rights, contact us through the Discord link in the website footer and include your RunCloud9 account email. We may need to verify your identity before fulfilling a request.
If you are not satisfied with our response, you may have the right to complain to a data protection authority in your country.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: We use essential cookies and similar technologies for sign-in and security. Analytics cookies and similar technologies (PostHog) are used only if you accept analytics in the cookie banner or choose Cookie settings in the website footer. See our Cookie Policy at /cookies for details.

sections.heading: Children
paragraphs: RunCloud9 is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child provided us information, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure. Report suspected security issues through the Discord contact method in the footer.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We may update this policy. We will post the revised version on this page and update the "Last updated" date. Material changes may be communicated by email or in-product notice where appropriate. If we later offer paid plans, we may collect payment-related information through a payment processor and will update this policy before doing so.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Data controller: the operator of RunCloud9. For privacy requests or account deletion, contact us through the Discord server linked in the website footer. Include your RunCloud9 account email so we can verify your request.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This policy explains how RunCloud9 uses cookies and similar technologies. Essential cookies are required for sign-in and security. Analytics cookies are optional and help us understand product usage.

sections.heading: Essential cookies
paragraphs: We use cookies and similar technologies required for sign-in, session management, and security. These are provided through our authentication provider (Supabase) and are necessary for the product to work. You cannot turn off essential cookies while using RunCloud9.

sections.heading: Analytics cookies
paragraphs: If you choose Accept analytics in the cookie banner, we load PostHog to collect usage analytics. PostHog may set cookies or use local storage (including localStorage+cookie persistence) to assign a distinct id and record product events such as sign-in, deployment, and session activity.
Analytics cookies are not set until you opt in. If you choose Essential only, we do not initialize PostHog.

sections.heading: How to change your choice
paragraphs: Use Cookie settings in the website footer to reopen the banner and switch between Essential only and Accept analytics.
You can also review this policy at any time on this page (/cookies).

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: For how we handle personal data, see our Privacy Policy at /privacy.
